# Contributing to Locvel

Thanks for helping. Locvel is open source, privacy-first, local-first software.

## Before you start

- Search existing issues and pull requests first — the work may already be underway.
- For anything bigger than a typo or small bug fix, open an issue first and wait for a maintainer to accept it (`Issue accepted`). Small fixes go straight to a pull request.
- Questions and ideas go to GitHub Discussions, not issues. Issues are for bugs only.

## How to contribute

1. Fork the repo, create a branch, make one change per pull request.
2. Add or update tests for code changes. Run the repo's test command before opening the PR.
3. Add a changelog entry: one file in `.changelog/<PR-number>.md`, one line, under Added / Fixed / Changed / Deprecated / Removed / Security.
4. Sign off every commit (DCO): `git commit -s` adds a `Signed-off-by:` line. By signing off you certify the Developer Certificate of Origin (https://developercertificate.org/).
5. Fill in the pull request template: summary, test plan, checklist.

## AI-assisted contributions

AI may assist, but you must understand and be able to explain every change in your own words. Do not submit pull requests created by autonomous agents, and do not paste AI-generated replies to maintainers. Say in the PR description if AI helped.

## Licence

Contributions are licensed under the licence of the repo you contribute to (see its LICENSE file).
